answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 59125 Country: India Title: Theft by me Question: When I was 15 years old, I robbed a pair of slippers from masjid, my slippers were robbed so in angry I robbed someone else slippers. Please advice what should I do now. Answer ID: 59125 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 656/652/B=07/1436) You should give in charity an amount equal to the cost of that slippers on behalf of its owner. Also keep on doing taubah and istighfar. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
